risk.rationale: Medium. The work is on the shared renderer and a proposed v7 contract (D-LINE-WORKSPACE, `proposed`, so the backend may change any field) and it renders delivery confirmations for a client-bound send (INV-RESEND, effect_uncertain). It stays at medium rather than high because both new states are read views plus a link into the F-21 editor. All of it is on the mock, no send is made here, and nothing is released. SURFACES: ui (4 boards), api (E-WORK-ITEM `workspace` views, E-WORK-STEP via the editor), contract-change (proposed block and the receipt shape), external-messaging (client report delivery truthfulness). PRODUCT-ACCEPTANCE is not-required because both pages conform to the client-approved boards (design/review.json:38) and the rules (return needs a note, exact version sent, four cited parts) are on the boards and in screens.md:116. D-RETURN (model.json, `open`, owner "business owner with the backend developer"): the proposal is that every return creates a "correct and resubmit" task for the preparer, and the returned board matches it ("Edit your part, then Tola reassembles v2"). It is not in this task's gates and the frontend builds against it as a working assumption. It holds only the runtime behaviour: what the real backend creates on Return and how it numbers v2. Until it is decided, nothing derives that from the frontend. It does not block the build. D-ALERT-PROVIDERS (model.json, `open`): no WhatsApp or email provider is chosen and the accounts belong to PSL (I-03), so no real delivery confirmation exists. It holds only the real confirmation transition. It does not block the build, because the page renders confirmations from mock data and claims nothing the data does not say. Delivery confirmations and the "Verified" claim must not appear from anything but confirmation data. Backend items to record (not blocking): E-WORK-STEP, the `workspace` block and the reconcile reply are unimplemented; idempotency, the resend refusal and cite scoping are backend promises (BACKEND-HANDOFF.md priority 1 and "Added during F-21"); the client template is a test template until PSL supplies the real one. **Size:** one PR on the existing frame, 4 boards, two states on the same route, roughly 600 to 1,000 lines with fixtures and tests. If the spec shows more, drop the two phone boards to a follow-on first.
